content: service method StopUpdateSession [SWS_SM_91101] Upstream: RS_SM_00001 , RS_SM_00004 StopUpdateSession () Has to be called by Update And Configuration Management once the update is finished to let State Management know that the update is done and the Machine is in a stable state. Request will be rejected when RequestUpdateSession was not called successfully before.
